title: 美网变秀场：球员穿搭成零售新引擎，品牌营销新战场？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's go to the open because you and I are fans. We're getting scarlet into this as well.
segments.zh: 我们来看看美网公开赛，因为你我都是球迷。我们也对此充满热情。

segments.en: The dream is to get Alex Ayala to play Coco.
segments.zh: 梦想是让亚历克斯·艾亚拉对阵可可。

segments.en: And there you've got Nike playing new balance. And who in God's name knows what jewelry they're wearing.
segments.zh: 那里有耐克对阵新百伦。天知道他们戴的是什么珠宝。

segments.en: Talk about the aspirational luxury of mostly the women to be honest, draped at the US open, the monies.
segments.zh: 说到美网上的奢华梦想，主要是女性，她们身上穿的都是钱。

segments.en: It's millions, right? It is millions, but also you're creating style trends.
segments.zh: 价值数百万，对吧？确实是数百万，但同时也引领了时尚潮流。

segments.en: Look what Saba Luka's wearing. Everyone looks at me.
segments.zh: 看看萨巴·卢卡穿的什么。大家都看我。

segments.en: What is Osaka wearing every day when she walks in the match?
segments.zh: 大阪每天走进赛场时穿的是什么？

segments.en: It's something new and different. So yes, it's become fashion and function at the same time.
segments.zh: 每天都有新花样。所以，这既是时尚也是功能。

segments.en: Is there no winning at that? I think he plays a big game in it.
segments.zh: 难道没有赢家吗？我觉得他在其中扮演重要角色。

segments.en: He wins, Ralph Lauren wins at it. We have a lot of it.
segments.zh: 他赢了，拉夫·劳伦也赢了。我们有很多这样的。

segments.en: Frankly, Nike also wins at that too. So when Thompson you were out front and saying that stores are not dead.
segments.zh: 坦白说，耐克在这方面也赢了。汤普森，你之前说实体店没有消亡。

segments.en: It's not just stores anymore. It's the venue for people to see the products available.
segments.zh: 现在不仅仅是商店，更是人们看到产品的场所。

segments.en: But it's also at events like the US open. Exactly. It is at events.
segments.zh: 但也在像美国公开赛这样的活动中。没错，就是在活动中。

segments.en: And frankly, you look at what stores are doing these days. Whether they're creating styling sessions and bring your friend.
segments.zh: 坦白说，看看现在的商店在做什么。无论是举办造型课程，还是带朋友来。

segments.en: Whether they're introducing you to a new designer, there's a reason to go.
segments.zh: 无论是向你介绍新设计师，总有理由去逛。

segments.en: And frankly, every time you have a reason to go, it's a click, click, because you're buying one thing.
segments.zh: 坦白说，每次你有理由去，就会买一件东西。

segments.en: But oh, I didn't know I needed that. I'll buy that too. Your heart and soul is Bergdorf.
segments.zh: 但哦，我不知道我需要那个，我也会买。你的心在波道夫。

segments.en: Yes. How does Bergdorf survive? How does the world, London, Bergdorf, Pronto and Paris, how do they survive?
segments.zh: 是的。波道夫如何生存？伦敦、波道夫、普朗托和巴黎，它们如何生存？
